t: This is 29 Harley Street in Westminster. It was designed by Charles Voysey, who lived from 1857 to 1941. Voysey was an English architect and a furniture and textile designer. His early work was in wallpapers, fabrics and furnishings in an Arts and Crafts style, and he made an important contribution to the Modern Style. He's renowned mostly for his country houses, which makes a town building like this one a little unusual among his work.
